proof: Normalize the original sheet to[0,4]x[0,2]. Bottom-to-top leaves y in[1,2], with the true horizontal fold at y=1; left-to-right leaves x in[2,4], with the vertical fold at x=2. The punch is(2.25,1.75), near the free TOP y=2 and LEFT fold x=2. Undo folds gives x=1.75,2.25 and y=.25,1.75: only B. D has y=.75,1.25, requiring a punch near the bottom fold instead of the top free edge. A is not the two-reflection orbit, C and E have wrong exterior-side x coordinates. All five patterns, arrows, original dashed creases, X and holes remain unchanged.
